title: Can I Get the RAREST Checkmate?
summary: Tony tries to deliver the rarest checkmate: a doubly-disambiguated bishop capture that is also a discovered check and checkmate (from Paralogical's video), against Martin. He promotes two extra light-squared bishops (3 bishops able to reach one square), keeps one Martin pawn alive, sets a stalemate trap so Martin must push the pawn to b2, then plays B(c1)xb2 — doubly disambiguated, capture, discovered check, mate (~8:27).
rules: Challenge goal: the final move must be a bishop capture that needs double disambiguation in SAN (e.g. Bc1xb2: two other same-colour bishops could also reach that square, one sharing file and one sharing rank), which is also discovered check and checkmate.
Requires promoting two pawns to bishops of the same square colour as an existing bishop.
win_condition: Checkmate with a doubly-disambiguated bishop capture that is a discovered check; ordinary mates don't count.

current_impl_issues: Impl 'specialmate' k=pawn requires a pawn checkmate; the video's target is a doubly-disambiguated bishop capture discovered-check mate.
